psalms-lament-night.title: Psalms — Prayer at night by lamplight (Psalms 13; 42)
psalms-lament-night.alt: Night engraving of a bearded man with clasped hands looking upward at a table with a burning oil lamp and scrolls, beside a window showing stars and a lit walled city

psalms-tree-water.title: Psalms — The tree planted by streams (Psalm 1)
psalms-tree-water.alt: Engraving of a bearded man seated against a large tree with exposed roots, holding a scroll beside a rushing stream, with a dry cracked plain and a bare tree at the right

revelation-lamb-scroll-v02.title: Revelation — The Lamb and the scroll, resting on the ledge (Revelation 5)
revelation-lamb-scroll-v02.alt: Engraving of a white Lamb with several horns and eyes standing behind a sealed scroll with six seals on a rock ledge, before a glowing city, with angels and worshipers

revelation-lampstands-witness.title: Revelation — The glorified figure among seven lampstands (Revelation 1:9–20)
revelation-lampstands-witness.alt: Engraving of a radiant robed figure with a blazing face standing among seven flaming lampstands in dark clouds, a kneeling man at lower left reaching toward him

revelation-multitude-worship.title: Revelation — The great multitude with palm branches (Revelation 7:9–17)
revelation-multitude-worship.alt: Engraving of smiling men, women and a child of many backgrounds holding palm branches and looking up, a huge crowd behind them and waterfalls leading to a distant city

revelation-new-creation-city.title: Revelation — The open gates and the tree of life, ancient dress (Revelation 21–22)
revelation-new-creation-city.alt: Engraving of a family in ancient robes looking toward tall open city gates, a large central tree, waterfalls and a river, with small groups walking in toward the city

revelation-new-creation-city-v02.title: Revelation — The open gates and the tree of life, mixed modern dress (Revelation 21–22)
revelation-new-creation-city-v02.alt: Engraving of people of many backgrounds, some in ancient robes and some in modern clothes, gazing toward open city gates, a large central tree, waterfalls and a river

romans-grafted-olive.title: Romans — The grafted olive tree (Romans 11)
romans-grafted-olive.alt: Engraving of a large olive tree with a bound graft on one branch, a group of men, women and a boy touching the trunk and looking up at its olives

romans-groaning-creation.title: Romans — Creation waits in hope (Romans 8)
romans-groaning-creation.alt: Engraving of a family and a standing traveler on cracked rocks looking up at sunbeams through clouds, a small green shoot growing from the stones before them

ruth-gleaning-field.title: Ruth — Ruth gleans in Boaz’s field (Ruth 2)
ruth-gleaning-field.alt: Engraving of a young woman in a headcovering kneeling to gather grain in a wheat field, with an older bearded man with a staff standing behind her and reapers at work

ruth-naomi-child.title: Ruth — Naomi holds the baby (Ruth 4)
ruth-naomi-child.alt: Engraving of a smiling elderly Naomi cradling a swaddled baby while a smiling Ruth leans in beside her, with a doorway and village behind

song-of-songs-garden-beloved.title: Song of Songs — The garden and the beloved (Song of Songs 4:12–5:1; 6:2–3)
song-of-songs-garden-beloved.alt: Engraving of a smiling bearded man and a veiled woman embracing in a walled garden full of white flowers, with cypress trees, a gate and a small fountain behind

song-of-songs-love-strength.title: Song of Songs — Love strong as death (Song of Songs 8:6–7)
song-of-songs-love-strength.alt: Engraving of two people's clasped hands joined over a rushing stream, only their arms and robes shown, with olive branches and a hill town behind

titus-elders-community.title: Titus — Appointing elders in the courtyard (Titus 1:5–9)
titus-elders-community.alt: Sepia engraving of a bearded man gesturing with open hands to a circle of seated and standing elders in a courtyard, a scroll and jug on a table, a hillside town behind

titus-good-works.title: Titus — Doing good works, repairing a neighbor’s door (Titus 3:1–8, 14)
titus-good-works.alt: Sepia engraving of a kneeling man hammering a plank onto a stone doorway as an old man steadies it, while a smiling family carries baskets of bread and a jug up the street

zechariah-garments-renewed.title: Zechariah — Joshua’s clean garments (Zechariah 3)
zechariah-garments-renewed.alt: Engraving of a kneeling bearded priest being given a clean turban and robe by two attendants, while a man at left drops his soiled garments into a flaming bowl

zechariah-humble-king.title: Zechariah — The humble king on a donkey (Zechariah 9)
zechariah-humble-king.alt: Engraving of a robed figure riding a donkey, seen from behind with disciples following, approaching the stone gate of a walled hilltop city beneath an olive tree

zechariah-lampstand-olives.title: Zechariah — The lampstand and two olive trees (Zechariah 4)
zechariah-lampstand-olives.alt: Engraving of a seven-branched lampstand with lit flames glowing between two fruiting olive trees, with the prophet Zechariah watching from behind at lower left

zephaniah-day-darkness.title: Zephaniah — The day of darkness (Zephaniah 1)
zephaniah-day-darkness.alt: Engraving of the prophet Zephaniah on a hillside pointing toward a walled city burning beneath massive dark smoke clouds, with villagers watching beside him

zephaniah-gathered-home.title: Zephaniah — The scattered gathered home (Zephaniah 3)
zephaniah-gathered-home.alt: Engraving of weary exiles with bundles, an old man leaning on a younger one, and a child running to be welcomed by cheering people at an open city gate
